summary: Filter chips: a nullable field offers the "is empty" operator (filterq.OpEmpty, wire form `field:empty:`, filterbuilder.FieldDef.Nullable, Solid FilterBuilderField.nullable); filterq.AppendSQL renders a FilterSet as PostgreSQL predicates from a field → column map (custom predicates for computed fields), and Condition.MatchValue/MatchValues/MatchBool/MatchDate/MatchNumber apply the same semantics to lists assembled in memory. Scaffold tables take a filter chip bar through table.WithFilterBar(bar, oob): it sits under the toolbar on every screen width instead of being folded into the mobile filters drawer, renders once, and re-renders out-of-band on row swaps. TableDefinition.WithFilterBar does the same for definition-built tables. filterq.RepoFilters turns chips into repo.FieldFilter values for pkg/repo repositories. The finance accounts list (/finance/accounts) replaces its created-at drawer filter with chips: currency, has balance, balance range, created at (old CreatedAt.From/To links still work). Positions (/positions) and departments (/departments) lists get chips too: department and status for positions; parent department (including none) and status for departments; the search form now pushes its state to the URL and infinite scroll keeps the conditions. New opt-in date presets this_quarter and last_quarter (filterq.PresetThisQuarter / PresetLastQuarter) for reports that close by quarter. filterbuilder.FieldDef.Single (filterq.Field.Single) limits a reference field to one value: a plain select in the editor, multi-value or duplicate conditions dropped on decode.
